name: 91790 · West Covina, CA
findings: ZIP 91790 (West Covina) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91790 (West Covina) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
81% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91790 (West Covina) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).
